emails.title: Máy quét không lưu tệp
emails.subject: Scans disappear after completion
emails.incoming:
Hello,
I installed your scanner on Monday. It captures each page, but I cannot find the files after scanning. I have checked my Documents folder and tried a second computer. Our office needs to scan several contracts this week. Could you help me solve this problem?
Nora Lee
emails.task: Trả lời với vai trò hỗ trợ kỹ thuật; đưa hai hướng dẫn xử lý và hỏi một câu hỏi về thiết bị/phần mềm.
emails.outline: Opening: ghi nhận lỗi. Body: chọn lại thư mục lưu; kiểm tra quyền ghi của phần mềm; hỏi phiên bản ứng dụng. Ending: đề nghị gửi hướng dẫn theo phiên bản.
emails.vocabulary: save location = vị trí lưu; write permission = quyền ghi; application version = phiên bản ứng dụng; scanned file = tệp đã quét; shared drive = ổ đĩa dùng chung.
samples:
Dear Nora,

Thank you for describing the problem with your scanner. I am sorry that you have been unable to locate your contract files.

First, please open the scanning application and select a new save location, such as a folder on your desktop. Scan one page and check that folder immediately afterward. Second, make sure that the application has permission to write files to the selected folder. A restricted shared drive may prevent it from saving the scan.

Could you please tell me which version of the scanning application you are using? Once I have that information, I can send you the appropriate setup guide.

Kind regards,
Evan Park
ClearScan Support

Hello Nora,

I appreciate the details you provided about the missing scans. Please try changing the destination folder in the application settings. For the test, choose a local folder rather than a network drive so that you can check where the file appears.

We also recommend reviewing the application's file access permissions. If access to your chosen folder is blocked, allow it and scan a single page again. These two checks will help us identify whether the issue concerns the save location or file access.

Which application version is installed on your computer? I will use your answer to prepare more specific instructions.

Best wishes,
Evan Park
emails.explanation: provided là quá khứ khi nhắc thông tin đã gửi; recommend reviewing dùng V-ing; If access ... is blocked, allow it là điều kiện + mệnh lệnh. Không cần dùng câu phức ở mọi câu.

emails.title: Bàn làm việc giao sai kích thước
emails.subject: Desk size does not match my order
emails.incoming:
Hello,
My order confirmation lists a desk that is 120 centimeters wide, but the desk delivered this morning is 160 centimeters wide. It does not fit our reception area. I still have the packaging and would prefer the correct size rather than a refund. Please explain what happens next.
Amir Khan
emails.task: Nhân viên chăm sóc khách hàng; đưa hai thông tin về đổi hàng và hỏi một câu hỏi.
emails.outline: Xác nhận sai kích thước → ngày đổi → chi phí/thu hồi → hỏi thời gian nhận.
emails.vocabulary: replacement = hàng thay thế; collect = đến lấy; delivery charge = phí giao; original packaging = bao bì gốc.
samples:
Dear Amir,

We apologize for delivering a desk in the wrong size. We can exchange it for the 120-centimeter model on Thursday, and our delivery team will collect the larger desk during the same visit.

There will be no collection or delivery charge for this exchange. Please keep the desk in its original packaging if possible so that the team can transport it safely. You will receive a confirmation message after we book the visit.

Would you prefer a morning or an afternoon delivery on Thursday? Your answer will help us arrange a convenient time for your reception staff.

Kind regards,
Lena Ortiz
Cedar Office Furniture
emails.explanation: Thông tin 1 = lịch đổi và thu hồi; thông tin 2 = miễn phí; câu hỏi = chọn khung giờ. apologize for delivering; so that + S + can + V.

emails.title: Hỏi bảo hành máy lọc không khí
emails.subject: Warranty for a noisy purifier
emails.incoming:
Hello,
I bought a FreshRoom purifier four months ago. It now makes a loud noise when I select the highest setting. I have cleaned the removable filter, but the noise remains. Could you tell me whether the warranty includes an inspection and what I should prepare?
Mei Chen
emails.task: Nhân viên bảo hành; cung cấp hai thông tin và yêu cầu một tài liệu.
emails.outline: Phạm vi kiểm tra → giấy tờ cần chuẩn bị → yêu cầu gửi hóa đơn.
emails.vocabulary: inspection = kiểm tra; proof of purchase = chứng từ mua; manufacturing fault = lỗi sản xuất; serial number = số sê-ri.
samples:
Dear Mei,

Thank you for asking about the noise from your purifier. Our twelve-month warranty includes an inspection for possible manufacturing faults, so your unit is still within the inspection period. If the technician confirms a covered fault, the repair will be free.

For the appointment, please prepare the unit's serial number and a brief description of when the noise occurs. These details will help the technician examine the correct components. You do not need to remove any internal parts before the visit.

Please send us a copy of your purchase receipt so that we can register the warranty request.

Best regards,
FreshRoom Service Team
emails.explanation: Phạm vi bảo hành + chuẩn bị; yêu cầu gửi hóa đơn là request, không bắt buộc phải viết thành câu hỏi trong đề này. If ... confirms, ... will be.

emails.title: Bộ lắp ráp thiếu linh kiện
emails.subject: Missing brackets in shelf kit
emails.incoming:
Hello,
I opened the shelf kit from order BW-804 this afternoon. The wooden panels and screws are included, but the two wall brackets shown on the parts list are missing. I cannot finish the installation without them. Could you arrange a solution?
Sofia Ramos
emails.task: Nhân viên đơn hàng; đưa một giải pháp, cung cấp một thông tin giao hàng, hỏi một câu hỏi.
emails.outline: Gửi linh kiện còn thiếu → thời gian → xác nhận địa chỉ.
emails.vocabulary: bracket = giá đỡ; parts list = danh sách linh kiện; dispatch = gửi hàng; confirm = xác nhận.
samples:
Dear Sofia,

I am sorry that the wall brackets were missing from your shelf kit. We will send two replacement brackets at no additional cost, so you will not need to return the wooden panels or screws.

The parts will be dispatched tomorrow by express delivery and should arrive within two business days. We will send you a tracking link as soon as the courier collects the package. Please keep the incomplete shelf uninstalled until all the required parts arrive.

Could you please confirm that the delivery address on order BW-804 is still correct? We can finalize the shipment as soon as we receive your confirmation.

Kind regards,
BuildWell Orders
emails.explanation: Giải pháp = gửi 2 giá đỡ; thông tin = lịch giao; câu hỏi = địa chỉ. should arrive diễn đạt dự kiến, không cam kết tuyệt đối.

emails.title: Ngừng hợp đồng giao tài liệu
emails.subject: Courier service review
emails.incoming:
Hello,
Our current courier has missed several scheduled collections this month. Please review whether we should continue the service. If you recommend ending the contract, explain your reasons and suggest how we can keep deliveries running during the change.
Victor Allen, Operations Manager
emails.task: Nhân viên hành chính; nêu hai lý do kết thúc hợp đồng và một phương án chuyển tiếp.
emails.outline: Quan điểm → chậm lấy hàng ảnh hưởng công việc → khó liên hệ → đơn vị tạm thời.
emails.vocabulary: scheduled collection = lượt lấy hàng theo lịch; notice period = thời hạn báo trước; temporary provider = nhà cung cấp tạm thời.
samples:
Dear Victor,

After reviewing this month's delivery records, I recommend ending the courier contract after the required notice period.

First, missed collections have delayed the documents our clients need before their appointments. Staff have had to arrange separate transport, which has increased our workload. Second, the courier's support line has not provided reliable updates when a collection is missed. This makes it difficult for us to tell clients when their documents will arrive.

To maintain deliveries during the change, we could use a local courier on a weekly agreement while we compare longer-term providers. I can request quotes and prepare a transition schedule for your review.

Best regards,
Dana Brooks
emails.explanation: Đủ 2 lý do khác nhau và 1 phương án. Không thêm câu hỏi chỉ vì thuộc Part 2. recommend ending; could use đề xuất mềm.

emails.title: Quy trình trả bộ chuyển đổi màn hình
emails.subject: Returning an unused adapter
emails.incoming:
Hello,
The adapter I ordered arrived yesterday. Before opening the box, I realized that I had selected the wrong connector type. The package is still sealed. Could you explain the return process and the expected refund time?
Owen Reed
emails.task: Nhân viên đổi trả; đưa hai bước trả hàng và một thông tin về hoàn tiền.
emails.outline: Điền biểu mẫu → đóng gói/gửi → thời gian hoàn.
emails.vocabulary: sealed = còn niêm phong; return label = nhãn trả hàng; process a refund = xử lý hoàn tiền.
samples:
Dear Owen,

Thank you for explaining the situation. To begin the return, please complete the return form in your order account and select “incorrect connector” as the reason. The system will then provide a prepaid return label.

Next, place the sealed adapter box inside a protective shipping box, attach the label, and take the package to the courier location shown on the label. Please keep the collection receipt until the return is complete.

We will process your refund to the original payment method within five business days after receiving and checking the package. Your bank may require additional time to display the refund.

Kind regards,
LinkPort Returns Team
emails.explanation: Hai bước có trình tự; thời gian hoàn có điểm bắt đầu rõ. after receiving and checking song song V-ing.

emails.title: Hỏi chương trình khuyến mãi trực tuyến
emails.subject: Discount for evening courses
emails.incoming:
Hello,
I saw a discount banner on your website, but I could not find the conditions. I am interested in the evening presentation course. Does the offer apply to that course, and can I use it if I register with a colleague?
Hana Mori
emails.task: Nhân viên tuyển sinh; cung cấp hai thông tin về ưu đãi và hỏi một câu hỏi về nhu cầu học.
emails.outline: Khóa áp dụng → đăng ký cùng đồng nghiệp → hỏi lịch.
emails.vocabulary: eligible = đủ điều kiện; enrollment = đăng ký học; course fee = học phí; available session = buổi có thể học.
samples:
Dear Hana,

Thank you for your interest in our evening presentation course. The current offer gives new students a fifteen-percent discount on this course when they register before the end of the month.

You and your colleague can each receive the discount if both of you are new students. Please submit separate enrollment forms and include the same group reference so that our team can place you in the same class. The offer cannot be combined with another discount.

Would you prefer the Tuesday evening class or the Thursday evening class? Once you choose a session, I can send the course schedule and registration instructions.

Best regards,
Weekend Learning Center
emails.explanation: Điều kiện áp dụng + điều kiện học đôi; câu hỏi về lịch. Dữ kiện ưu đãi được đặt riêng cho bài luyện.

emails.title: Báo cáo phàn nàn lặp lại
emails.subject: Feedback from collection-point customers
emails.incoming:
Hello,
Several customers have complained about the collection desk this week. Please summarize two recurring problems and recommend one improvement that we can introduce before the next busy period.
Grace Bell, Store Manager
emails.task: Thành viên nhóm trải nghiệm khách hàng; nêu hai vấn đề và một cải tiến.
emails.outline: Hàng chờ → thông báo chưa rõ → quy trình thông báo.
emails.vocabulary: recurring problem = vấn đề tái diễn; collection desk = quầy nhận hàng; notification = thông báo; reference number = mã tham chiếu.
samples:
Dear Grace,

I have reviewed the comments received this week. Two problems appear repeatedly in the feedback.

First, customers are waiting in the collection line even when their orders have not reached the desk. Second, the messages sent to customers do not explain which entrance leads to the collection area. Several people have joined the payment line by mistake and then had to queue again.

I recommend introducing a revised collection message before the next busy period. It should be sent only after the order reaches the desk and should include a simple map of the correct entrance. This change would address both the unnecessary waiting and the confusion about where to go.

Best regards,
Mina
emails.explanation: Hai vấn đề; một cải tiến xử lý cả hai. recommend introducing; should be sent bị động sau modal.

emails.title: Thiết bị không tương thích
emails.subject: Dock not connecting to my tablet
emails.incoming:
Hello,
I purchased your docking station last Friday, but my tablet does not recognize it. The indicator light is on. I would like to know whether the dock is compatible with my device before I try another cable.
Lucas Green
emails.task: Nhân viên hỗ trợ; hỏi hai câu hỏi để xác định tương thích và đưa một gợi ý kiểm tra.
emails.outline: Hỏi model → hỏi hệ điều hành → thử cổng trực tiếp.
emails.vocabulary: compatible with = tương thích với; operating system = hệ điều hành; extension cable = cáp nối dài.
samples:
Dear Lucas,

Thank you for contacting us about the docking station. The indicator light shows that the dock is receiving power, but we need a few details to check device compatibility.

What is the exact model of your tablet? Could you also tell us which operating system version it is running? These details will allow us to compare your device with the dock's supported models and software requirements.

In the meantime, we suggest connecting the dock directly to the tablet without an extension cable. This will help us check whether the connection setup is contributing to the problem. Please include the result of that test in your reply.

Kind regards,
ConnectHub Support
emails.explanation: Hai câu hỏi thật, một gợi ý; không kết luận chắc chắn lỗi tương thích trước khi có model.

emails.title: Theo dõi kiện hàng đang giao
emails.subject: Tracking status has not changed
emails.incoming:
Hello,
My package has shown “at regional center” since yesterday morning. I need it for an exhibition on Friday. Could you tell me how to get an update and what I should do if it does not arrive in time?
Priya Shah
emails.task: Nhân viên giao hàng; cung cấp hai thông tin và hỏi một câu hỏi.
emails.outline: Cách nhận cập nhật → cách hỗ trợ nếu chậm → hỏi mã.
emails.vocabulary: tracking number = mã theo dõi; regional center = trung tâm khu vực; delivery estimate = dự kiến giao.
samples:
Dear Priya,

I understand that you need the package before your exhibition. You can request the latest delivery estimate by entering your tracking number on our support page and selecting “request an update.” Our regional team will check the parcel's next scheduled movement.

If the revised estimate is later than Friday morning, our help desk can review whether collection from the local depot is available. Collection depends on where the package is located, so we will need to confirm this option before you travel there.

Could you please send your tracking number? I can then ask the regional team to review the package and contact you with an update.

Best regards,
ParcelLane Help Desk
emails.explanation: Cách cập nhật + lựa chọn hỗ trợ; hỏi mã theo dõi. Không hứa chắc chắn giao đúng hạn khi chưa có thông tin.

emails.title: Dời buổi họp tổng kết
emails.subject: New time needed for Friday review
emails.incoming:
Hello team,
Our client cannot attend Friday's review at 9 a.m. Please suggest another time that day, explain why it would work for your department, and ask me for any information you need before confirming the change.
Daniel Cho
emails.task: Thành viên nhóm dự án; đưa một thời gian thay thế, một lý do và một câu hỏi.
emails.outline: Đề xuất 2 giờ → báo cáo xong → hỏi khách có thể tham gia.
emails.vocabulary: reschedule = dời lịch; revised invitation = thư mời điều chỉnh; review meeting = buổi họp tổng kết.
samples:
Dear Daniel,

Our department could attend the review meeting at 2 p.m. on Friday. The analysts will have finished their morning data checks by then, so we can present the final figures rather than a preliminary report.

This time would also give us a short period to prepare the slides after lunch. We can keep the meeting to forty-five minutes and send the updated materials to the other departments beforehand. I will ask our analysts to reserve that period while we wait for confirmation.

Would the client be available at 2 p.m.? Once you confirm their availability, I can update our department's calendar and share the revised invitation.

Best regards,
Jordan
emails.explanation: Thời gian + lý do + câu hỏi; future perfect will have finished dùng cho việc hoàn tất trước mốc tương lai.

emails.title: Phòng họp đóng để sửa hệ thống chiếu sáng
emails.subject: Alternative room for training
emails.incoming:
Hello,
I understand that the main meeting room will be closed for lighting repairs next Wednesday. I am running a training session for twelve people that morning. Could you suggest another place and explain whether the equipment will be available?
Elena Scott
emails.task: Nhân viên quản lý cơ sở; đưa hai thông tin về phương án thay thế và hỏi một câu hỏi.
emails.outline: Phòng thay thế/sức chứa → thiết bị → hỏi giờ.
emails.vocabulary: facilities = cơ sở vật chất; accommodate = chứa đủ; projector = máy chiếu; reserve = đặt trước.
samples:
Dear Elena,

We can offer the training room on the second floor while the main meeting room is being repaired. It seats sixteen people, so it will accommodate your group of twelve comfortably.

The room has a projector and a whiteboard. We can also move the portable speaker there before your session if you need audio. Please bring your laptop's display adapter, as the projector uses an HDMI connection. A member of our team can help you test the setup before participants arrive.

What time will your training session begin and end? We will use that information to reserve the room and arrange equipment support.

Kind regards,
Facilities Team
emails.explanation: Phòng/sức chứa + thiết bị; một câu hỏi về khung giờ. is being repaired là bị động đang diễn ra.

emails.title: Hủy phòng đặt nhầm ngày
emails.subject: Incorrect arrival date
emails.incoming:
Hello,

I booked a room for November 14, but I meant to select November 21. My reservation number is HH-217. I have not paid yet, and I would like to change the date rather than cancel the booking. Could you explain the options?

Alice Wong
emails.task: Nhân viên đặt phòng; cung cấp hai thông tin về đổi lịch và hỏi một câu hỏi về nhu cầu lưu trú.
emails.outline: Xác nhận có thể đổi ngày → giải thích giá và hạn xác nhận → hỏi số đêm.
emails.vocabulary: reservation = đặt phòng; revised rate = giá điều chỉnh; availability = tình trạng phòng; confirm a booking = xác nhận đặt phòng
samples:
Dear Alice,

We can move reservation HH-217 to November 21 because rooms are currently available for that date. Your existing booking will remain active until you accept the change, so you do not need to cancel it first.

The revised rate is $95 per night, which is $10 more than the original rate. Please confirm the change by tomorrow afternoon so that we can hold the room and send an updated booking summary.

How many nights would you like to stay from November 21? I will check availability for the full visit before issuing the payment request.

Kind regards,
Harbor Hotel Reservations
emails.explanation: Hai thông tin: có thể chuyển ngày, giá và hạn xác nhận. Câu hỏi xác định số đêm, không yêu cầu trả tiền trước khi kiểm tra đủ chỗ. Can + V; before + V-ing.

emails.title: Đề nghị suất ăn cho khách có dị ứng
emails.subject: Lunch arrangements for workshop
emails.incoming:
Hello,

We need lunch for twenty participants at our workshop next Monday. Two participants cannot eat nuts, and one cannot consume dairy products. Please explain how you can accommodate these needs and tell me what information you require before confirming the order.

Ben Ortiz
emails.task: Nhân viên dịch vụ ăn uống; đưa hai thông tin về phương án suất ăn và hỏi một câu hỏi để chốt đơn.
emails.outline: Suất ăn tách riêng và nhãn → quy trình xử lý yêu cầu dị ứng → hỏi giờ dùng bữa.
emails.vocabulary: dietary requirement = yêu cầu chế độ ăn; separate meal = suất riêng; ingredient list = danh sách thành phần; serving time = giờ phục vụ
samples:
Dear Ben,

We can prepare separately labeled meals for the participants who avoid nuts or dairy products. Each meal will include an ingredient list so that the participants can review it before eating.

Our team will also use separate preparation equipment for these meals. Because allergy requirements can differ, we will ask the affected participants to review our proposed menu and handling arrangements before we confirm that the service is suitable. We will not substitute ingredients without approval.

What time should lunch be ready on Monday? Once we receive the serving time, we can send the menu and order summary for your review.

Best regards,
Maple Catering
emails.explanation: Hai thông tin: suất riêng có nhãn, quy trình chuẩn bị và duyệt menu. Hỏi giờ phục vụ. Before + mệnh đề; avoid + danh từ. Đây là tình huống ngôn ngữ giả định, không cam kết an toàn thực phẩm thực tế.

emails.title: Thay người tham dự hội thảo
emails.subject: Changing the attendee name
emails.incoming:
Hello,

My colleague Ravi cannot attend Thursday's workshop, so I would like to attend in his place. His registration number is NB-460. Please let me know whether a transfer is possible and what I need to bring to the event.

Carla Mendes
emails.task: Nhân viên sự kiện; cung cấp hai thông tin về chuyển đăng ký và yêu cầu một thông tin từ người nhận.
emails.outline: Cho phép chuyển trước hạn → giấy tờ mang theo → yêu cầu tên đầy đủ.
emails.vocabulary: registration transfer = chuyển đăng ký; confirmation message = thư xác nhận; identity document = giấy tờ tùy thân; attendee = người tham dự
samples:
Dear Carla,

We can transfer registration NB-460 to another attendee without charging an additional fee. Please submit the change before noon on Wednesday so that our team can prepare the correct name badge.

On Thursday, you should bring the updated confirmation message and a photo identity document. The check-in desk will open thirty minutes before the workshop begins, and the staff will use your revised registration details to issue the badge.

Please send your full name as you would like it to appear on the attendee list. Once we receive it, we will replace Ravi's details and email the updated confirmation directly to you.

Kind regards,
Northbridge Events
emails.explanation: Thông tin về chuyển đăng ký và giấy tờ; yêu cầu tên đầy đủ. As you would like it to appear mô tả cách ghi tên; will + V cho bước tiếp theo.

emails.title: Xin tài liệu đã dùng trong buổi đào tạo
emails.subject: Materials from the scheduling workshop
emails.incoming:
Hello,

I attended yesterday's scheduling workshop, but I could not download the practice files before the session ended. Could you send them to me and explain whether I can share them with colleagues who did not attend?

David Kim
emails.task: Nhân viên đào tạo; đưa hai thông tin về quyền truy cập/chia sẻ và hỏi một câu hỏi để gửi đúng tệp.
emails.outline: Link truy cập → chia sẻ nội bộ → hỏi định dạng.
emails.vocabulary: practice file = tệp thực hành; internal use = sử dụng nội bộ; editable version = bản chỉnh sửa được; access link = liên kết truy cập
samples:
Dear David,

The practice files are available through our staff learning portal. I can send you a direct access link, and you will be able to download the materials using your employee account until the end of next month.

You may share the files with colleagues inside the company, provided that the workshop title and author information remain included. Please do not upload them to a public website, as the examples contain internal work procedures.

Would you prefer the editable spreadsheet files or the PDF practice sheets? Your choice will help me send the most useful version for your team.

Best regards,
Staff Development
emails.explanation: Hai thông tin: cách truy cập/thời hạn, phạm vi chia sẻ. Câu hỏi về định dạng. Provided that + mệnh đề diễn tả điều kiện.

emails.title: Đổi lịch phỏng vấn do trùng lịch thi
emails.subject: Interview time conflict
emails.incoming:
Hello,

Thank you for inviting me to an interview on Tuesday at 10 a.m. Unfortunately, I have a university examination at that time. I remain interested in the assistant position. Could we arrange another time, and is there anything I should prepare beforehand?

Emma Tran
emails.task: Nhân viên tuyển dụng; đề xuất một lịch mới, nêu một yêu cầu chuẩn bị và hỏi một câu hỏi xác nhận.
emails.outline: Đề xuất thứ Tư 2 giờ → mang CV cập nhật → hỏi có tham gia được không.
emails.vocabulary: interview slot = khung giờ phỏng vấn; updated résumé = CV cập nhật; availability = khả năng tham dự; bring along = mang theo
samples:
Dear Emma,

Thank you for letting us know about the examination. We understand the conflict and can offer an interview on Wednesday at 2 p.m. The meeting will take place at the same office listed in your original invitation and should last about forty minutes.

Please bring an updated résumé so that the interviewers can discuss your recent coursework and experience. You do not need to prepare a formal presentation for this stage of the recruitment process.

Would Wednesday at 2 p.m. be convenient for you? Once you confirm, I will send a revised invitation and update the interviewers' calendars.

Kind regards,
Greenfield Recruitment
emails.explanation: Lịch thay thế, một yêu cầu mang CV và câu hỏi xác nhận rõ ràng. Would ... be convenient? là câu hỏi lịch sự; so that + S + can + V.

emails.title: Hỏi chỗ đỗ xe cho khách
emails.subject: Parking for visiting auditors
emails.incoming:
Hello,

Three auditors will visit our office tomorrow at 9 a.m. They are coming in one car and have asked about parking. Could you tell me where they should park and whether they need any permission before arriving?

Felix Grant
emails.task: Lễ tân tòa nhà; cung cấp hai thông tin về đỗ xe và yêu cầu một thông tin.
emails.outline: Vị trí chỗ khách → đăng ký trước và phí → yêu cầu biển số.
emails.vocabulary: visitor space = chỗ đỗ cho khách; vehicle registration = biển số xe; access permit = giấy phép vào; reception desk = quầy lễ tân
samples:
Dear Felix,

The auditors can park in the visitor spaces on level B1. They should enter through the east gate and follow the signs for reception rather than the staff parking section.

A visitor permit is required, but there is no parking charge for an appointment of up to four hours. We can arrange the permit in advance so that the gate attendant knows the vehicle is expected. The auditors should then collect their visitor badges from the reception desk.

Please send the car's registration number before 4 p.m. today. I will add it to tomorrow's access list and email you the parking directions.

Best regards,
Building Reception
emails.explanation: Hai thông tin: nơi đỗ xe, giấy phép và phí; yêu cầu biển số. Up to nêu giới hạn, rather than nêu lựa chọn đúng.

emails.title: Báo hóa đơn có phí trùng
emails.subject: Duplicate charge on invoice
emails.incoming:
Hello,

Invoice AC-905 appears to include the delivery charge twice. We ordered one shipment, and the goods arrived together. Please review the invoice and let me know whether I should pay the current amount or wait for a correction.

Gina Patel
emails.task: Nhân viên kế toán; cung cấp hai thông tin xử lý hóa đơn và hỏi một câu hỏi kiểm tra.
emails.outline: Tạm chưa trả phần sai → thời điểm hóa đơn mới → hỏi có trả rồi chưa.
emails.vocabulary: duplicate charge = phí tính trùng; corrected invoice = hóa đơn điều chỉnh; outstanding balance = số dư chưa trả; payment record = lịch sử thanh toán
samples:
Dear Gina,

Thank you for pointing out the duplicate delivery charge on invoice AC-905. Please wait for the corrected invoice before making a payment. We will keep the account open without applying a late fee while we review the disputed amount.

Our accounts team will check the shipment record this afternoon and send the revised invoice by tomorrow morning. The new document will show the delivery charge only once if the record confirms a single shipment, as you described.

Have you already made any payment against this invoice? That information will help us decide whether to update the outstanding balance or arrange a credit.

Kind regards,
Accounts Desk
emails.explanation: Hai thông tin: chờ hóa đơn mới và lịch xử lý; hỏi tình trạng thanh toán. Have you already made dùng hiện tại hoàn thành; if + hiện tại giữ điều kiện xác minh.

emails.title: Thay địa chỉ trước khi gửi hàng
emails.subject: New delivery address
emails.incoming:
Hello,

My office moved yesterday, and order PL-612 has not been dispatched yet. Could you send the stationery to our new address instead? Please explain what details you need and whether the change will delay delivery.

Henry Silva
emails.task: Nhân viên đơn hàng; yêu cầu hai thông tin địa chỉ và cung cấp một thông tin về lịch giao.
emails.outline: Yêu cầu địa chỉ đầy đủ → số điện thoại nhận hàng → giữ lịch nếu gửi trước hạn.
emails.vocabulary: dispatch = gửi hàng; postal code = mã bưu chính; contact number = số điện thoại liên hệ; scheduled delivery = lịch giao đã định
samples:
Dear Henry,

We can update the address for order PL-612 because it has not yet been dispatched. Please send the complete new street address, including the postal code, so that we can prepare the correct shipping label.

Could you also provide a contact telephone number for the person who will receive the package? The courier may need to call before entering the building, especially if there is no reception desk.

If we receive both details before noon today, the order will keep its original delivery schedule. Later changes may move dispatch to the following business day. I will confirm the schedule after updating the order.

Best regards,
PaperLane Orders
emails.explanation: Hai yêu cầu thông tin tách rõ: địa chỉ đầy đủ và điện thoại; thông tin lịch có điều kiện rõ. Has not yet been dispatched là hiện tại hoàn thành bị động.

emails.title: Đề xuất lịch dùng phòng tập
emails.subject: Preferred time for exercise sessions
emails.incoming:
Hello,

We plan to offer a weekly exercise session for office staff. Please suggest a suitable time, explain why it would work for your team, and tell us about one facility we should provide to make participation easier.

Iris Lee
emails.task: Nhân viên văn phòng; đề xuất một thời gian, một lý do và một tiện ích cần có.
emails.outline: Chiều thứ Năm sau giờ làm → không trùng chốt báo cáo → khu thay đồ.
emails.vocabulary: weekly session = buổi hằng tuần; changing area = khu thay đồ; participation = việc tham gia; reporting deadline = hạn nộp báo cáo
samples:
Dear Iris,

I suggest holding the weekly exercise session at 5:30 p.m. on Thursday. Most members of our team finish work at 5 p.m., so they would have time to change and walk to the activity room without leaving their desks early.

Thursday would also avoid our Friday reporting deadline. Staff are usually preparing final figures on Friday afternoon, which makes it harder to commit to another activity that day.

Please provide a small changing area with secure storage for work clothes and bags. This would make it easier for people who travel by public transport to participate without carrying extra belongings throughout the session.

Best regards,
Owen
emails.explanation: Thời gian, lý do và tiện ích khác nhau. Would have/would make diễn tả lợi ích dự kiến của đề xuất, không phải quyết định đã chốt.

emails.title: Yêu cầu hỗ trợ phòng học quá đông
emails.subject: Room capacity for onboarding
emails.incoming:
Hello,

The room assigned for Monday's onboarding seats twelve people, but seventeen employees have confirmed attendance. Please suggest a solution, explain how it would work, and ask me for any detail you need before arranging it.

Jonas Park
emails.task: Trợ lý đào tạo; đề xuất một giải pháp, giải thích cách thực hiện và hỏi một câu hỏi.
emails.outline: Đổi phòng lớn → bố trí bàn và thiết bị → hỏi giờ kết thúc.
emails.vocabulary: room capacity = sức chứa phòng; seating layout = cách xếp chỗ; onboarding = đào tạo nhân viên mới; confirm attendance = xác nhận tham dự
samples:
Dear Jonas,

I suggest moving Monday's onboarding to the second-floor seminar room. It seats twenty-four people, so all seventeen employees could attend together without dividing the group.

We can arrange the tables in a U shape and move the portable projector from the original room before the session. This layout would give participants a clear view of the screen while leaving enough space for the group activities. I will also update the room details in the joining instructions once the booking is approved.

What time will the session finish? I need the full time period to check the seminar room's availability and arrange the equipment transfer.

Kind regards,
Lena
emails.explanation: Giải pháp đổi phòng, cách bố trí và câu hỏi về giờ kết thúc. Without + V-ing; enough + danh từ + for.

emails.title: Thông báo đổi điểm đón xe
emails.subject: Temporary pickup location
emails.incoming:
Hello,

The usual staff pickup point will be blocked by roadwork next week. Please propose another location, give one reason for choosing it, and explain how we should notify employees before Monday morning.

Kara Chen
emails.task: Điều phối viên xe đưa đón; đề xuất điểm đón, một lý do và một cách thông báo.
emails.outline: Cổng thư viện → có mái che và lối dừng → email kèm bản đồ.
emails.vocabulary: pickup point = điểm đón; roadwork = công trình đường; sheltered area = khu có mái che; route map = bản đồ tuyến
samples:
Dear Kara,

I recommend using the entrance to the public library as the temporary staff pickup point. It is one block from the usual stop, and the driver can reach it without entering the roadwork area.

The library entrance has a covered waiting area and a designated vehicle bay. This would allow staff to wait away from moving traffic while the bus stops in a suitable place.

We should email employees a marked route map on Friday and ask team supervisors to mention the change before the weekend. The message should include the temporary location, the unchanged pickup time, and a contact number for anyone who cannot find the stop.

Best regards,
Company Transport
emails.explanation: Đủ địa điểm, lý do và phương án thông báo; không tự đổi giờ đón. Recommend using; should + V.

emails.title: Xin bổ sung thời gian nộp báo cáo
emails.subject: Extra time for survey report
emails.incoming:
Hello,

The survey data arrived two days later than planned. I can complete the report, but I cannot check all the charts before tomorrow's deadline. Could you advise whether an extension is possible and tell me what to send in the meantime?

Liam Brooks
emails.task: Quản lý dự án; đưa một quyết định về hạn nộp, một yêu cầu tạm thời và hỏi một câu hỏi về tiến độ.
emails.outline: Gia hạn hai ngày → gửi bản số liệu đã kiểm → hỏi phần còn thiếu.
emails.vocabulary: extension = gia hạn; verified figures = số liệu đã kiểm tra; draft chart = biểu đồ nháp; remaining section = phần còn lại
samples:
Dear Liam,

You may submit the final survey report on Friday instead of tomorrow. The two-day extension will give you time to check the charts, but please keep Friday's deadline so that we can prepare for the client review.

In the meantime, send me the verified figures and any completed charts by tomorrow afternoon. Please label unfinished material clearly as a draft so that it is not circulated as final information. I will use only the checked sections in our internal update.

Which parts of the report still require data checks? Your answer will help me decide whether another team member can assist you.

Best regards,
Mara
emails.explanation: Quyết định hạn, yêu cầu bản tạm và câu hỏi về phần cần hỗ trợ. May + V cho phép; so that + mệnh đề mục đích.

emails.title: Đăng ký mượn thiết bị trình chiếu
emails.subject: Projector loan for client visit
emails.incoming:
Hello,

I need a portable projector for a client visit on Thursday afternoon. The meeting is outside our office, and I will return the equipment on Friday morning. Could you explain the borrowing process and any checks I should make before taking it away?

Maya Singh
emails.task: Nhân viên thiết bị; nêu hai bước mượn/kiểm tra và hỏi một câu hỏi.
emails.outline: Đặt thiết bị trong hệ thống → thử kết nối tại quầy → hỏi giờ lấy.
emails.vocabulary: loan form = phiếu mượn; connection test = kiểm tra kết nối; adapter = bộ chuyển đổi; collection time = giờ lấy
samples:
Dear Maya,

Please complete the equipment loan form in the staff portal and list Friday morning as the return time. Select the portable projector rather than the fixed meeting-room unit so that we reserve the correct device for your client visit.

Before leaving the equipment desk, connect the projector to your laptop and test a sample slide. Bring any adapter your laptop requires, as we cannot guarantee that the standard cable will fit every model. The desk team can help with this connection test.

What time would you like to collect the projector on Thursday? We will have it charged and ready for that time.

Kind regards,
Equipment Desk
emails.explanation: Hai bước và câu hỏi giờ lấy; không nhầm loại cố định/di động. Rather than phân biệt lựa chọn; before leaving dùng V-ing.

emails.title: Khách không nhận được vé điện tử
emails.subject: Confirmation email not received
emails.incoming:
Hello,

I paid for two concert tickets yesterday, but the confirmation email has not arrived. I have checked my spam folder. The concert is on Saturday, and I would like to know how I can obtain the tickets before then.

Noah Evans
emails.task: Nhân viên phòng vé; đưa hai cách nhận vé và hỏi một câu hỏi xác minh.
emails.outline: Gửi lại vào email đúng → nhận tại quầy → hỏi mã giao dịch.
emails.vocabulary: electronic ticket = vé điện tử; transaction reference = mã giao dịch; collection desk = quầy nhận vé; resend = gửi lại
samples:
Dear Noah,

We can resend the electronic tickets after verifying the booking and the email address used at checkout. Please avoid making a second purchase while we investigate, as your existing payment may already be attached to a confirmed reservation.

If email delivery remains unsuccessful, you can collect printed tickets at the box office before Saturday's concert. Bring the booking confirmation we issue after the check and a photo identity document. The collection desk will open one hour before the performance.

Could you please provide the transaction reference shown on your payment receipt? This will help us locate the booking accurately.

Best regards,
River Arts Box Office
emails.explanation: Hai cách nhận vé và câu hỏi mã giao dịch. After verifying; if + hiện tại. Không yêu cầu thông tin thẻ đầy đủ.

emails.title: Đề nghị thay ca trực
emails.subject: Covering a morning shift
emails.incoming:
Hello,

I cannot work my Saturday morning shift because I have a family appointment. A colleague is willing to exchange shifts, but I need to know the procedure. Please explain what to do and whether the exchange requires approval.

Olivia Reed
emails.task: Điều phối viên ca; cung cấp hai thông tin về quy trình và hỏi một câu hỏi về người đổi.
emails.outline: Nộp phiếu có cả hai người → cần quản lý duyệt → hỏi tên đồng nghiệp.
emails.vocabulary: shift exchange = đổi ca; approval = phê duyệt; roster = lịch phân ca; submit a request = nộp yêu cầu
samples:
Dear Olivia,

Please submit a shift-exchange request through the scheduling portal. The form should identify both shifts and include confirmation from you and the colleague who has agreed to exchange with you.

The exchange requires approval from the duty manager before either employee changes attendance plans. Once it is approved, we will update the official roster and send both of you a confirmation message. An informal agreement alone does not change the scheduled shifts.

Who has agreed to take your Saturday morning shift? I can check that person's availability and confirm that the proposed exchange meets our staffing requirements.

Kind regards,
Shift Coordinator
emails.explanation: Quy trình nộp và phê duyệt, câu hỏi tên người đổi. Who has agreed dùng hiện tại hoàn thành; before + mệnh đề.

emails.title: Hỏi về phí sử dụng thư viện
emails.subject: Joining as a temporary resident
emails.incoming:
Hello,

I will live in the city for six months and would like to join the library. Could you explain whether temporary residents can become members and what documents I need to bring when applying?

Peter Lane
emails.task: Nhân viên thư viện; cung cấp hai thông tin về đăng ký và hỏi một câu hỏi về địa chỉ.
emails.outline: Cho phép đăng ký sáu tháng → giấy tờ và phí → hỏi đã có chứng từ địa chỉ chưa.
emails.vocabulary: temporary resident = cư dân tạm thời; proof of address = chứng từ địa chỉ; membership card = thẻ thành viên; application = đơn đăng ký
samples:
Dear Peter,

Temporary residents can apply for a six-month library membership. The card allows you to borrow books and use the reading rooms, and there is no registration fee for this type of membership.

Please bring a photo identity document and a recent document showing your local address, such as a rental agreement. Our staff will check these documents and ask you to complete a short application form at the membership desk. You can usually collect the card during the same visit.

Do you already have a document showing your address in the city? If not, I can explain the alternative documents we accept.

Best regards,
City Library Membership
emails.explanation: Hai thông tin về điều kiện/quyền lợi và giấy tờ; hỏi chứng từ địa chỉ. Allows you to borrow; showing bổ nghĩa document.

emails.title: Xin báo giá in tài liệu
emails.subject: Printing manuals for a seminar
emails.incoming:
Hello,

Our team needs forty copies of a twenty-page seminar manual. The pages are in color, and the event is on October 28. Please explain your printing options and ask for any detail you need to prepare an accurate quote.

Quinn Zhao
emails.task: Nhân viên bán hàng; nêu hai lựa chọn in và hỏi một câu hỏi về đóng quyển.
emails.outline: In màu toàn bộ → màu trang đầu/đen trắng bên trong → hỏi đóng gáy.
emails.vocabulary: quotation = báo giá; binding = đóng gáy; double-sided = hai mặt; full-color = in màu toàn bộ
samples:
Dear Quinn,

We can print all twenty pages in full color on standard paper. This option would preserve the appearance of every chart and photograph in your manual, and we can print the pages double-sided if you prefer.

A lower-cost option is to use a color cover with black-and-white inside pages. Before selecting it, please check that the charts remain understandable without color. We can prepare one sample copy for your approval before printing all forty manuals.

Would you like the manuals stapled or spiral-bound? The binding choice will affect both the price and the preparation time, so I need it before issuing the quotation.

Kind regards,
BrightPrint Sales
emails.explanation: Hai lựa chọn khác nhau, hỏi kiểu đóng gáy; không tự báo giá chính xác khi chưa đủ thông tin. Before selecting dùng V-ing; would affect chỉ hệ quả dự kiến.

emails.title: Báo lỗi máy bán đồ uống
emails.subject: Payment accepted but no drink supplied
emails.incoming:
Hello,

The drinks machine on level three accepted my payment this morning, but it did not provide the bottle I selected. The same thing happened to another employee. Could you explain how to recover the payment and what you will do about the machine?

Rosa Miller
emails.task: Nhân viên cơ sở; đưa hai thông tin về hoàn tiền/sửa máy và yêu cầu một thông tin giao dịch.
emails.outline: Hoàn tiền qua biểu mẫu → tạm ngừng máy và kiểm tra → yêu cầu thời gian/số tiền.
emails.vocabulary: vending machine = máy bán hàng tự động; refund request = yêu cầu hoàn tiền; transaction time = giờ giao dịch; out of service = tạm ngừng hoạt động
samples:
Dear Rosa,

You can recover the payment by submitting the short refund form on the facilities portal. Our team will compare the report with the machine's transaction record and return the confirmed amount to the original payment method.

We will mark the machine as out of service today and ask the maintenance provider to inspect its dispensing mechanism. Please use the machine on level one while the inspection is taking place. We will remove the notice only after a successful test.

Please include the approximate transaction time and the amount paid in your refund request. Those details will help us identify the correct payment.

Best regards,
Facilities Service
emails.explanation: Hai thông tin xử lý tiền/máy và một yêu cầu chi tiết giao dịch. While + mệnh đề; after + cụm danh từ.

emails.title: Đề nghị hỗ trợ nhân viên mới
emails.subject: Buddy arrangement for new starters
emails.incoming:
Hello,

Two new employees will join our team next week. Please recommend a way to support them during the first three days, explain one benefit of your suggestion, and tell me what resource you need to put it into practice.

Samira Khan
emails.task: Thành viên nhóm; một đề xuất, một lợi ích và một nguồn lực cần hỗ trợ.
emails.outline: Phân người hướng dẫn riêng → hỏi nhanh đúng người → thời gian giải phóng cho mentor.
emails.vocabulary: buddy = đồng nghiệp hướng dẫn; first-week schedule = lịch tuần đầu; workload = khối lượng việc; practical question = câu hỏi thực tế
samples:
Dear Samira,

I recommend assigning a different buddy to each new employee for the first three days. The buddies could explain the daily schedule, introduce key contacts, and demonstrate the tasks that the new employees will practice first.

This arrangement would give each newcomer a clear person to approach with practical questions. It would also reduce the confusion caused by receiving different instructions from several colleagues at once.

To make the plan workable, I would need you to reserve thirty minutes of each buddy's schedule every morning. Reducing their normal workload slightly during those periods would allow them to provide support without rushing the demonstrations.

Best regards,
Alex
emails.explanation: Đề xuất phân buddy, lợi ích người liên hệ rõ, nguồn lực thời gian. Need you to reserve; without rushing.

emails.title: Xin thay đổi định dạng cuộc họp
emails.subject: Remote attendance for monthly review
emails.incoming:
Hello,

Several team members will be visiting customers on the day of our monthly review. Please suggest a meeting format, explain two reasons it would help, and tell me what preparation you recommend.

Tara Lewis
emails.task: Nhân viên phòng ban; một định dạng họp, hai lý do và một bước chuẩn bị.
emails.outline: Họp kết hợp → giữ người đi công tác tham gia → giảm dời lịch → thử âm thanh trước.
emails.vocabulary: hybrid meeting = họp kết hợp; remote participant = người tham gia từ xa; audio check = kiểm tra âm thanh; shared agenda = chương trình họp chung
samples:
Dear Tara,

I suggest holding a hybrid review, with office staff in the meeting room and traveling colleagues joining through the video platform.

First, this would allow the customer-facing staff to share their updates without returning to the office solely for the meeting. Second, we could keep the original date rather than postponing decisions until everyone is in the same place. The remaining staff would therefore receive the information they need on schedule.

Before the review, we should test the room microphone with one remote participant. A brief audio check would reveal whether people outside the room can hear all speakers clearly.

Best regards,
Nina
emails.explanation: Hai lý do khác nhau: tham gia từ xa, giữ tiến độ quyết định. Một bước chuẩn bị kiểm tra mic. Rather than postponing.

emails.title: Hỏi dịch vụ giữ hành lý sau trả phòng
emails.subject: Luggage storage after checkout
emails.incoming:
Hello,

My train leaves at 6 p.m., but checkout is at noon. I would like to explore the city during the afternoon. Could you tell me whether I can leave my bags at the hotel and how I should collect them afterward?

Umar Ali
emails.task: Lễ tân khách sạn; cung cấp hai thông tin giữ/nhận hành lý và hỏi một câu hỏi.
emails.outline: Có thể giữ miễn phí trong ngày → thẻ nhận và giờ quầy → hỏi số túi.
emails.vocabulary: luggage storage = giữ hành lý; collection tag = thẻ nhận; checkout = trả phòng; storage area = khu giữ đồ
samples:
Dear Umar,

You may leave your bags in our supervised storage area after checking out. This service is free for departing guests until 8 p.m. on the same day, so it should fit your train schedule.

At checkout, the receptionist will give you a collection tag for each bag. Please keep the tags and present them when you return. The main reception desk will handle the collection, and staff may ask you to confirm the room number connected with the storage record.

How many bags would you like us to store? I will let the afternoon team know so that they can prepare enough space.

Kind regards,
Station Hotel Reception
emails.explanation: Hai thông tin giữ/nhận, hỏi số túi. May leave; after checking out. Không suy ra bảo hiểm hành lý ngoài đề.

emails.title: Đặt lịch kiểm tra mạng văn phòng
emails.subject: Intermittent network connection
emails.incoming:
Hello,

Our team's internet connection drops several times each afternoon, although the connection is stable in the morning. We have restarted the router. Please arrange a check and let us know what information would help you diagnose the problem.

Vera Chen
emails.task: Nhân viên IT; đề xuất một lịch kiểm tra và hỏi hai câu hỏi chẩn đoán.
emails.outline: Kiểm tra đúng giờ lỗi → hỏi thiết bị bị ảnh hưởng → hỏi mốc bắt đầu.
emails.vocabulary: intermittent = chập chờn; affected device = thiết bị bị ảnh hưởng; network log = nhật ký mạng; diagnostic check = kiểm tra chẩn đoán
samples:
Dear Vera,

We can check the connection tomorrow between 2 and 3 p.m., when the issue is more likely to occur. A technician will monitor the network and compare the results with the router log rather than asking your team to restart the equipment repeatedly.

Does the connection drop on all devices or only on computers in one part of the office? Also, when did you first notice the afternoon interruptions? These details will help us narrow the investigation and prepare the right testing equipment.

Please keep a brief record of any interruption today, including its time and duration, so that we can compare it with tomorrow's observations.

Best regards,
IT Help Desk
emails.explanation: Đề xuất lịch và đúng hai câu hỏi chẩn đoán; thêm yêu cầu ghi lỗi hỗ trợ, không thay thế hai câu hỏi. More likely to occur; rather than asking.

emails.title: Khách yêu cầu đổi món trong đơn đặt ăn
emails.subject: Changing items before collection
emails.incoming:
Hello,

I ordered six lunches for collection at noon, but one colleague has asked for a vegetarian option. The order number is CF-118. Could you explain whether we can replace one meal and whether the total price will change?

Will Foster
emails.task: Nhân viên quán; cung cấp hai thông tin đổi món/giá và hỏi một câu hỏi về món thay.
emails.outline: Cho đổi trước 11 giờ → giá bằng nhau → hỏi chọn món nào.
emails.vocabulary: vegetarian option = món chay; collection order = đơn tự đến lấy; price difference = chênh lệch giá; substitute = thay thế
samples:
Dear Will,

We can replace one lunch in order CF-118 as long as you confirm the change before 11 a.m. The kitchen has not started preparing your meals yet, so the noon collection time can remain unchanged.

Our vegetable wrap and chickpea salad cost the same as the lunch you originally selected. Choosing either option would therefore keep the total price unchanged. We will label the replacement separately so that your colleague can identify it easily.

Would you prefer the vegetable wrap or the chickpea salad? Please reply with your choice, and I will update the order before sending it to the kitchen.

Kind regards,
Café Orders
emails.explanation: Hai thông tin đổi/giá và câu hỏi lựa chọn. As long as + mệnh đề; would keep diễn tả hệ quả chọn món.

emails.title: Xin phép tổ chức góc trao đổi sách
emails.subject: Small book exchange in the lounge
emails.incoming:
Hello,

Some colleagues would like to create a book exchange in the staff lounge. Please tell us whether this would be permitted and what rules we should follow. We want to keep the area tidy and avoid taking space from other activities.

Xenia Brown
emails.task: Quản lý văn phòng; đưa một quyết định, hai quy định và hỏi một câu hỏi về người phụ trách.
emails.outline: Cho thử bốn tuần → một kệ duy nhất → không để lối đi → hỏi người dọn.
emails.vocabulary: book exchange = trao đổi sách; trial period = thời gian thử; shared space = không gian chung; designated shelf = kệ chỉ định
samples:
Dear Xenia,

You may run the book exchange for a four-week trial period. At the end of the trial, we will review whether it is useful and whether it fits comfortably into the lounge.

Please keep all books on the small designated shelf beside the noticeboard. Do not add boxes or extra furniture without approval. Also, make sure that the books do not extend into the walkway or cover information posted on the board. These rules will keep the shared space usable for other staff.

Who will be responsible for checking the shelf each week and removing damaged or unclaimed books?

Best regards,
Office Manager
emails.explanation: Một quyết định thử, hai quy định: giới hạn kệ và giữ lối đi/bảng thông báo; câu hỏi người phụ trách. Make sure that + mệnh đề.

emails.title: Xin thông tin khóa học tối hết chỗ
emails.subject: Waiting list for the evening class
emails.incoming:
Hello,

The Wednesday evening class is full, but it is the only session that fits my current work schedule. Could you tell me whether there is a waiting list and what alternatives might be available if no place opens?

Yara Scott
emails.task: Nhân viên trung tâm; cung cấp hai thông tin về danh sách chờ/phương án khác và yêu cầu một thông tin.
emails.outline: Danh sách chờ theo thứ tự → buổi online cùng giờ → yêu cầu số điện thoại.
emails.vocabulary: waiting list = danh sách chờ; available place = chỗ còn trống; online session = buổi trực tuyến; contact details = thông tin liên hệ
samples:
Dear Yara,

We maintain a waiting list for the Wednesday evening class and offer places in the order requests are received. If a place becomes available, we will contact you and hold it for twenty-four hours while you decide.

If the class remains full, you could join the online session held at the same time. It covers the same course content, although the group activities take place through the video platform. You may transfer to the classroom session later if a suitable place opens.

Please send a telephone number where we can reach you about a waiting-list offer.

Kind regards,
Language Center
emails.explanation: Hai thông tin và yêu cầu số liên hệ. In the order requests are received; although phân biệt hình thức hoạt động.

emails.title: Xác nhận lịch giao hàng số lượng lớn
emails.subject: Delivery of exhibition panels
emails.incoming:
Hello,

We are expecting twelve display panels for our exhibition on Friday. The venue allows deliveries only between 8 and 10 a.m. Please confirm whether you can meet that window and explain how the delivery team will unload the panels.

Zack Martin
emails.task: Nhân viên kho; cung cấp hai thông tin lịch/dỡ hàng và hỏi một câu hỏi về lối vào.
emails.outline: Chọn khung 8–9 → hai nhân viên và xe đẩy → hỏi cửa giao.
emails.vocabulary: delivery window = khung giờ giao; unloading = dỡ hàng; loading entrance = cửa nhập hàng; handling team = nhóm vận chuyển
samples:
Dear Zack,

We can schedule the twelve display panels for delivery between 8 and 9 a.m. on Friday. This falls within the venue's permitted window. The driver will call your on-site contact shortly before arrival to confirm that the delivery area is ready.

Two members of our handling team will unload the panels using a padded trolley. They will move them to the agreed ground-floor storage point, but assembly is not included in the delivery service.

Which entrance should the vehicle use at the venue? Please send its location and any height restriction so that we can select a suitable vehicle.

Best regards,
Warehouse Dispatch
emails.explanation: Hai thông tin về khung giờ và dỡ hàng, một câu hỏi cửa vào. Passive will be avoided by active team roles; assembly exclusion làm phạm vi rõ.

emails.title: Yêu cầu sửa tên trên chứng chỉ
emails.subject: Name printed incorrectly
emails.incoming:
Hello,

I received my course certificate today, but my family name is misspelled. The certificate shows Daz instead of Das. Could you explain how I can obtain a corrected certificate and whether I need to return the original?

Anika Das
emails.task: Nhân viên quản lý khóa học; cung cấp hai thông tin chỉnh chứng chỉ và yêu cầu một minh chứng.
emails.outline: Cấp bản mới trong ba ngày → không phải gửi bản cũ, đánh dấu thay thế → yêu cầu ảnh bản sai.
emails.vocabulary: corrected certificate = chứng chỉ sửa lại; spelling error = lỗi chính tả; replacement copy = bản thay thế; verification = xác minh
samples:
Dear Anika,

We apologize for the spelling error on your certificate. After checking the course record, we will issue a corrected electronic certificate within three business days. A printed replacement can be collected from our office afterward.

You do not need to send the original back. We will mark it as replaced in our system, and you should use only the corrected certificate when sharing your qualification details.

Please send a clear photograph of the incorrect certificate, including its reference number. This will allow us to locate the record and confirm exactly which text needs correction before producing the replacement.

Kind regards,
Course Administration
emails.explanation: Hai thông tin cấp lại/không trả bản cũ, yêu cầu ảnh có mã. After checking; allow us to locate.

emails.title: Báo thay đổi số lượng khách dự họp
emails.subject: More delegates than expected
emails.incoming:
Hello,

Our conference booking was for thirty delegates, but we now expect thirty-eight. The date and meeting time have not changed. Please explain whether the room can accommodate the larger group and whether we need to adjust the catering order.

Bruno Costa
emails.task: Nhân viên địa điểm; cung cấp hai thông tin phòng/đồ ăn và hỏi một câu hỏi về số cuối.
emails.outline: Phòng đủ nếu bố trí kiểu lớp → thêm tám suất ăn → hỏi chốt số ngày nào.
emails.vocabulary: delegate = đại biểu; classroom layout = bố trí kiểu lớp; final headcount = số người cuối; catering order = đơn ăn uống
samples:
Dear Bruno,

The booked room can accommodate thirty-eight delegates in a classroom layout. We will replace the large discussion tables with smaller rows so that everyone has a clear view of the presentation screen. The meeting date and time can remain unchanged.

The catering order should be increased by eight lunches to match the revised attendance. We can send an updated quotation once you confirm the number, and any additional dietary requirements should be included at that stage.

When will you be able to confirm the final headcount? Our catering team needs the confirmed number at least two business days before the conference.

Best regards,
Conference Venue
emails.explanation: Hai thông tin phù hợp tăng 30 lên 38, hỏi hạn chốt. Should be increased bị động; so that chỉ mục đích bố trí.

emails.title: Đề nghị sửa cửa kho bị kẹt
emails.subject: Storeroom door sticking
emails.incoming:
Hello,

The storeroom door is difficult to open, and staff have been pulling it forcefully to collect supplies. Could you arrange a repair and explain how we should access the supplies until the door has been checked?

Chloe Nguyen
emails.task: Nhân viên bảo trì; nêu lịch kiểm tra, một phương án tạm và hỏi một câu hỏi xác định vị trí.
emails.outline: Kiểm tra sáng mai → dùng nguồn cấp tạm ở hành chính → hỏi mã phòng.
emails.vocabulary: sticking door = cửa bị kẹt; temporary supply point = điểm cấp tạm; room number = số phòng; maintenance visit = lượt bảo trì
samples:
Dear Chloe,

We will arrange for a maintenance technician to inspect the door tomorrow morning. Please do not continue pulling it forcefully, as this may damage the handle or frame before the technician can identify the cause.

Until the inspection is complete, staff can collect frequently used supplies from the administration desk. We will ask that team to prepare a temporary supply box today so that employees do not have to use the affected entrance for routine items.

Could you confirm the storeroom number and floor? I will add those details to the work request and let you know when the technician is on the way.

Kind regards,
Maintenance Office
emails.explanation: Lịch kiểm tra, phương án tạm, câu hỏi vị trí. Until + hiện tại; frequently used bổ nghĩa supplies. Không hướng dẫn tự sửa kỹ thuật.

emails.title: Hỏi gia hạn gói phần mềm nhóm

emails.incoming:
Hello,

Our annual subscription expires next month. We currently pay for fifteen users, but the team now has ten. Could you explain whether we can reduce the number at renewal and how we should complete the renewal process?

Diego Ruiz

emails.outline: Giảm xuống mười khi gia hạn → hóa đơn mới và hạn trả → hỏi danh sách user.
emails.vocabulary: subscription renewal = gia hạn đăng ký; active account = tài khoản hoạt động; billing period = kỳ thanh toán; user license = giấy phép người dùng

Dear Diego,

You can reduce the subscription from fifteen users to ten when the new annual period begins. The current licenses will remain active until the existing subscription expires, so your team does not need to remove users immediately.

To renew, please review the revised quotation we will send this week and approve it through the account portal. We will then issue an invoice for ten licenses, with payment due before the start of the new period.

Which ten user accounts would you like to keep active? Please identify them in your reply so that we can prepare the renewal without removing an account your team still needs.

Best regards,
TeamTools Accounts
emails.explanation: Hai thông tin về đổi số và quy trình; hỏi danh sách giữ. When + hiện tại cho mốc tương lai; without removing.

emails.title: Yêu cầu hỗ trợ tìm đồ bỏ quên

Dear Elena,

You can check the lost-property collection by contacting the hall office during opening hours. I will also review the items handed in after yesterday's workshop and compare them with the cleaning team's collection register.

Does the blue notebook have your name or another identifying detail on its cover? Also, approximately where were you sitting in room C? These two details will help us distinguish your notebook from other items and ask the cleaners to check the correct part of the room.

If we find a likely match, we will contact you before arranging collection. Please do not travel to the hall until we have confirmed that an item is available.

Kind regards,
Community Hall Office

Best regards,
Sales Team

Which country is the address in? Could you also tell us which browser you are using? The postal-code format may depend on the selected country, and the browser information will help our technical team reproduce the problem.

If an error message appears, please include its wording in your reply as well.

Kind regards,
Membership Support

emails.title: Đề xuất hoạt động cho ngày nhóm

emails.incoming:
Hello,

We have a half day available for a team event next month. Please recommend one activity, give two reasons it would suit a mixed group of staff, and tell me about any practical arrangement we should make first.

Holly Adams
emails.task: Nhân viên đề xuất hoạt động; một hoạt động, hai lý do và một bước chuẩn bị.
emails.outline: Workshop nấu ăn nhóm → nhiều vai trò không cần thể lực cao → khuyến khích phối hợp → hỏi chế độ ăn trước.
emails.vocabulary: group activity = hoạt động nhóm; mixed abilities = năng lực khác nhau; shared task = nhiệm vụ chung; dietary preference = sở thích/chế độ ăn
samples:
Dear Holly,

I recommend a small-group cooking workshop for the half-day event. The instructor could give each team a simple menu and divide the preparation into several manageable tasks.

First, staff could choose different roles, such as measuring ingredients or organizing the table, so the activity would not depend on everyone's physical fitness. Second, preparing one shared meal would encourage people from different departments to coordinate their work and communicate directly.

Before booking, we should collect dietary requirements and preferences from all participants. The provider could then propose a suitable menu and explain which arrangements are possible before we confirm the workshop.

Best regards,
Riley
emails.explanation: Một hoạt động, hai lý do và một bước chuẩn bị. Could choose; before booking. Không coi hoạt động phù hợp mọi người khi chưa hỏi nhu cầu.

Dear Ivan,

Security can accept a small equipment parcel after 6 p.m. if the delivery has been registered in advance. The driver must come to the main gate, where the evening officer can check the expected delivery list before signing for the package.

We will store the parcel in the secure cabinet beside the security desk and notify your team the following morning. Large items that require unloading equipment cannot be handled by the evening officer, so please confirm that the replacement part is a normal parcel.

Please send the courier's name and tracking number before 3 p.m. tomorrow so that we can register the delivery.

Kind regards,
Security Office
emails.explanation: Hai thông tin về điều kiện nhận và bảo quản; yêu cầu thông tin courier. Cannot be handled là bị động; if + hiện tại.

emails.title: Báo quầy lễ tân cần biển chỉ dẫn

emails.incoming:
Hello,

Visitors have been arriving at our staff service desk instead of the main reception. Please explain two possible reasons for the confusion and recommend one change that we can make this week.

Kenji Sato
emails.task: Nhân viên hành chính; nêu hai nguyên nhân có thể và một đề xuất.
emails.outline: Tên hai quầy giống nhau → bảng hướng dẫn cũ → một bảng chỉ dẫn rõ từ cửa.
emails.vocabulary: direction sign = biển chỉ dẫn; desk label = nhãn quầy; outdated map = bản đồ lỗi thời; main reception = lễ tân chính
samples:
Dear Kenji,

There are two likely reasons why visitors are reaching the staff service desk. First, both desks currently display similar labels, so someone unfamiliar with the building may not understand which one handles visitors. Second, the map beside the entrance still shows the old reception position from before the office rearrangement.

I recommend replacing the entrance map with a clear direction board this week. It should identify “Visitor Reception” by name and use an arrow pointing to the current desk. This single change would correct the outdated route and clarify the function of the destination.

I can prepare the proposed wording for review tomorrow.

Best regards,
Office Administration
emails.explanation: Hai nguyên nhân có thể và một thay đổi xử lý cả hai. Likely reasons tránh khẳng định nguyên nhân chưa xác minh; before + cụm danh từ.

emails.incoming:
Hello,

Our supplier would like to discuss the revised delivery arrangement next week. Please suggest a meeting time, identify two topics we should cover, and ask me for one detail you need before sending the invitation.

Leila Hassan
emails.task: Nhân viên mua hàng; đề xuất một lịch, hai chủ đề và hỏi một câu hỏi.
emails.outline: Thứ Ba 11 giờ → khung giờ giao → liên hệ khi trễ → hỏi đại diện nhà cung cấp.
emails.vocabulary: delivery arrangement = phương án giao; contingency contact = liên hệ khi có sự cố; supplier representative = đại diện nhà cung cấp; meeting invitation = thư mời họp

Dear Leila,

I suggest meeting the supplier at 11 a.m. on Tuesday. Our purchasing team is available then, and the warehouse supervisor can join before the afternoon deliveries begin.

We should cover two main topics. The first is the revised delivery window, including how much notice the warehouse will receive before each shipment. The second is the contact procedure for delays, so that both teams know whom to call when the agreed window cannot be met.

Who will represent the supplier at the meeting? Please send that person's name and email address, and I will prepare an invitation with the proposed agenda.

Best regards,
Purchasing Team
emails.explanation: Một lịch, hai chủ đề riêng và một câu hỏi đại diện. Including + mệnh đề danh từ; cannot be met bị động sau modal.

essays.title: Employers should provide a small annual learning budget for every employee. Do you support this policy? Explain your position with examples.
essays.topic: Chính sách & phúc lợi công ty
essays.prompt: Employers should provide a small annual learning budget for every employee. Do you support this policy? Explain your position with examples.
ideas: Cập nhật kỹ năng
chủ động chọn khóa phù hợp
samples:
Employees are expected to adapt as tools and customer needs change, but many cannot afford additional courses on their own. I believe employers should give every employee a modest annual learning budget. With clear conditions, this benefit can improve daily work and encourage people to take responsibility for their development.

The first advantage is that employees can update skills directly related to their responsibilities. A company does not always need to organize a large training event to solve a small knowledge gap. For example, imagine a warehouse assistant who regularly prepares inventory reports by hand. A short spreadsheet course could teach her to calculate totals and identify missing entries more accurately. She could then use the same method every week and explain it to colleagues. The value of the course would extend beyond one employee because the whole team would receive more reliable information. A small investment could therefore improve a repeated business process.

A second advantage is that a personal budget gives employees a practical reason to plan their learning. When workers can choose from approved courses, they are more likely to select something they will actually use. A receptionist, for instance, might choose a course on handling difficult conversations after noticing that complaints are becoming more complex. Discussing that choice with a supervisor would help connect the training to a clear goal. Afterward, the receptionist could demonstrate new techniques and reflect on which ones worked. This creates a more meaningful learning cycle than attending an unrelated session simply because it appears on the calendar.

Naturally, employers should set a spending limit and require a brief explanation of how each course supports the job. They should also provide reasonable time to apply what has been learned. These conditions would keep the benefit manageable without making it difficult to access. Overall, a modest learning budget is a useful policy because it strengthens practical skills and helps employees become active participants in their own development.
essays.outline: Mở bài: ủng hộ → thân 1: kỹ năng cập nhật, ví dụ nhân viên quản lý kho → thân 2: động lực và trách nhiệm, ví dụ lễ tân → kết: ủng hộ, có giới hạn hợp lý.
essays.vocabulary: modest = vừa phải; knowledge gap = lỗ hổng kiến thức; inventory report = báo cáo tồn kho; approved course = khóa được phê duyệt; apply a skill = áp dụng kỹ năng.
essays.explanation: who regularly prepares là mệnh đề quan hệ; could teach her to calculate = khả năng trong tình huống giả định; because + S + V giải thích vì sao lợi ích lan sang nhóm. Kết luận đưa điều kiện, không đổi sang phản đối.
essays.analysis: Đánh giá ngân sách học tập cho mọi nhân viên, không viết chung về lợi ích của giáo dục. Lập trường: đồng ý với ngân sách nhỏ và điều kiện rõ ràng.
essays.summary: Ngân sách nhỏ giúp khắc phục lỗ hổng kỹ năng và thúc đẩy tự học có mục tiêu. Cần giới hạn chi tiêu, lý do chọn khóa và thời gian áp dụng.

essays.title: Would you choose flexible starting hours or a free daily lunch as an employee benefit? Explain which would be more useful to you.
essays.topic: Chính sách & phúc lợi công ty
essays.prompt: Would you choose flexible starting hours or a free daily lunch as an employee benefit? Explain which would be more useful to you.
ideas: Giờ linh hoạt giảm xung đột
bữa trưa giảm chi phí
essays.outline:
Mở bài: nêu lựa chọn và tiêu chí so sánh; không chỉ liệt kê các phương án.

Thân bài 1: Giờ linh hoạt giảm xung đột. Giải thích cơ chế tạo ra kết quả.

Thân bài 2: bữa trưa giảm chi phí. Phát triển một hệ quả khác hoặc giới hạn của quan điểm.

Ví dụ gợi ý: Tự xây dựng tình huống cụ thể phù hợp hai luận điểm của đề; nêu ai làm gì và kết quả.

Kết bài: khẳng định lựa chọn trong hoàn cảnh đã nêu; nhắc đánh đổi với các phương án còn lại.
essays.vocabulary: a practical benefit = lợi ích thực tế; a potential drawback = hạn chế có thể có; a clear priority = ưu tiên rõ ràng; in this situation = trong tình huống này
essays.explanation: Giữ mỗi đoạn tập trung một luận điểm, dùng câu giải thích trước ví dụ. Ví dụ riêng của đề: Tự xây dựng tình huống cụ thể phù hợp hai luận điểm của đề; nêu ai làm gì và kết quả. Đây là tình huống minh họa, không phải số liệu nghiên cứu. Dùng hiện tại đơn cho nhận định chung; can/may cho khả năng; if + hiện tại đơn để nêu điều kiện. Không dùng số liệu không có nguồn.
essays.analysis: Dạng Chọn 1 trong 2. Xác định đối tượng và phạm vi trong đề; các luận điểm dưới đây là một hướng triển khai, có thể chọn lập trường khác nếu giải thích nhất quán.
essays.summary: Giờ linh hoạt giảm xung đột; bữa trưa giảm chi phí

essays.title: Discuss the advantages and disadvantages of reserving every activity before a holiday begins.
essays.prompt: Discuss the advantages and disadvantages of reserving every activity before a holiday begins.
ideas: Chủ động ngân sách
mất linh hoạt
samples:
Booking holiday activities in advance can make a trip feel organized before it begins. Travelers know where they will go and can prepare the necessary tickets and transport. However, reserving every activity also creates a schedule that may be difficult to change. This approach offers useful certainty, but it can reduce the freedom that makes a holiday enjoyable.

The main advantage is that travelers can plan their spending and avoid disappointment. Popular tours and small classes may have limited places, especially during busy seasons. A family that books an activity early can compare prices, check what is included, and make sure that everyone can participate. For example, reserving a morning boat trip before departure allows the family to organize transport and plan the remaining meals around it. They do not have to spend their first evening searching for available places. This can be particularly helpful when the holiday is short and there is little time to solve unexpected booking problems.

The main disadvantage is that a fully reserved schedule leaves little room for changing circumstances. Weather, tiredness, or a newly discovered interest may make an original plan less attractive. Suppose travelers arrive in a town and find a local festival that was not included in their research. If they have already paid for activities throughout the day, attending the festival may mean losing money or missing another reservation. A crowded schedule can also turn minor delays into repeated stress. Instead of enjoying a place, travelers may spend much of their time checking whether they can reach the next appointment on time.

Overall, advance reservations are useful for activities that are essential or likely to sell out. Nevertheless, booking every part of a trip creates unnecessary restrictions. A more balanced approach is to reserve a few important activities and leave open periods between them. This allows travelers to benefit from preparation while still responding to the weather, their energy, and the opportunities they discover along the way.
essays.outline: kiểm soát chi phí/đảm bảo chỗ → mất linh hoạt → đánh giá cách đặt chọn lọc.
essays.vocabulary: in advance = trước; limited places = số chỗ có hạn; reservation = đặt chỗ; sell out = hết chỗ; restriction = hạn chế.
essays.explanation: that may be difficult to change mệnh đề quan hệ; If ... have ... may mean hệ quả có thể xảy ra; Instead of enjoying sau giới từ dùng V-ing. Tránh viết cả bài thành “I prefer ...” rồi bỏ phần bất lợi.
essays.analysis: Phân tích việc đặt trước mọi hoạt động cho kỳ nghỉ.

essays.title: For a new employee, which is the best introduction to a job: a mentor, a video course, or a printed manual? Defend your choice.
essays.prompt: For a new employee, which is the best introduction to a job: a mentor, a video course, or a printed manual? Defend your choice.
ideas: Hỏi trực tiếp
luyện theo tình huống
samples:
A new employee needs more than a list of instructions to become comfortable in an unfamiliar workplace. Given a choice between a mentor, a video course, and a printed manual, I would choose a mentor as the main introduction to the job. Personal guidance helps new staff understand real situations and receive feedback before they develop unhelpful habits.

One important benefit is that a mentor can explain how general rules apply to specific cases. A manual may describe a standard procedure, but daily work often includes details that are difficult to anticipate. Imagine a new employee at a hotel who has learned the normal check-in steps. A guest arrives early, the room is not ready, and the guest needs to leave a valuable bag. An experienced mentor can explain the available options, show how to record the arrangement, and describe when a manager should be involved. The new employee learns not only what to do but also why the procedure protects both the guest and the hotel.

A mentor can also observe performance and provide feedback at the right moment. New employees do not always recognize their own mistakes. They may believe that they have understood a task because they watched someone complete it once. When a mentor watches them practice, small problems become visible. For instance, a trainee might enter the correct booking details but forget to confirm the departure date aloud. The mentor can explain the risk and ask the trainee to repeat the conversation. This immediate correction makes the lesson easier to remember and gives the trainee a clear standard to follow.

Video courses and manuals still have useful roles. Videos can demonstrate a routine consistently, and manuals are convenient when someone needs to check a rule later. However, neither can respond as naturally to an unexpected question during practice. I would therefore use them as supporting resources while giving the mentor the central role. For an employee who is just beginning a job, responsive guidance and timely feedback are the strongest foundation.

essays.vocabulary: guidance = sự hướng dẫn; anticipate = dự liệu; trainee = người đang được đào tạo; timely feedback = phản hồi đúng lúc; supporting resource = nguồn hỗ trợ.
